name: Edly
description_en:
Edly is an Open edX-powered learning suite combining an LMS, Studio course authoring, administrative tools, discovery/storefront functions and the Edly Go mobile app. It also offers hosting and customization services.

Buying Edly SaaS differs from commissioning a self-hosted Open edX installation. Platform subscription, development services and underlying open-source software do not share one price or one license assumption.
description_zh:
Edly 是基于 Open edX 的学习套件，包含 LMS、Studio 创课、管理工具、发现及店面功能和 Edly Go 移动应用，也提供托管及定制服务。

购买 Edly SaaS 与委托自托管 Open edX 安装不同，平台订阅、开发服务和底层开源软件不能共用一个价格或许可假设。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Understand each part of the Edly suite
sections.title_zh: 理解 Edly 套件的各部分
sections.en: The homepage separates LMS learning delivery, Studio authoring, Panel administration, Discovery branding/storefront and Go mobile access. It also advertises managed hosting, Open edX installation, migration and customization. An underlying platform relationship does not mean every service or Edly-specific extension is free or independently installable.
sections.zh: 首页区分 LMS 学习交付、Studio 创课、Panel 管理、Discovery 品牌及店面和 Go 移动访问，另提供托管、Open edX 安装、迁移与定制。基于某底层平台，不表示所有服务或 Edly 扩展都免费或可单独安装。

sections.en: Author a short course, create learner roles and publish a pilot offering. Check enrollment, an assignment submission and the report showing the learner outcome. If selling access, verify the storefront-to-enrollment handoff using a test order and the corresponding cancellation case before taking payment. Ecommerce and subscriptions are listed capabilities, but the actual configured payment and access flow was not tested here.
sections.zh: 编写短课程、配置学员角色并发布试点项目，检查选课、作业提交及结果报告。若销售课程，应在收款前用测试订单检查店面到选课的交接及取消路径。电商和订阅是列出的能力，但本文未测试实际支付及访问配置。

sections.title_en: Monthly active learners and service charges
sections.title_zh: 月活跃学员与服务费用
sections.en: The pricing page says billing is based on monthly active learners, invoiced after 30 days, and offers a 30-day trial for up to 20 active learners. The static calculator simultaneously shows $300 and $315 for zero learners, so it cannot substantiate a reliable starting invoice. Above 10,000 learners it directs readers to sales. Course-authoring services and other on-demand work carry separate effort-based charges; confirm which features and integrations are included rather than reading the benefit list as a free bundle.
sections.zh: 定价页说明按月活跃学员计费，30 天后开票，提供最多 20 名活跃学员的 30 天试用。静态计算器对零学员同时显示 300 和 315 美元，无法支持可靠起始账单；超过 10,000 人需联系销售。创课等按需服务另按工作量收费，应明确包含的功能与集成，不能把权益列表当作免费组合。

sections.title_en: Choose who operates the learning platform
sections.en: Start with a SaaS pilot or a scoped self-hosting proposal, then agree who handles upgrades, backups, identity and support. Test incomplete learning, failed enrollment and report export with representative content. Edly can fit organizations that want an Open edX-based learning operation with services, but a hosted suite is not proof of unrestricted source rights. Exact extension licenses, recovery guarantees and contractual data location remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先选择 SaaS 试点或明确的自托管方案，再约定升级、备份、身份和支持责任。用代表性内容检查未完成学习、选课失败及报告导出。希望结合服务运营 Open edX 学习平台的组织可考虑 Edly，但托管套件不证明源码权利无限制。具体扩展许可、恢复保证及合同数据位置仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Resolve calculator rates and included features with a quote; verify self-hosting scope, extension licenses and cancellation/enrollment behavior.
research_gaps.zh: 需以报价解决计算器费率和包含功能，确认自托管范围、扩展许可及取消选课行为。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
